description: Eval opportunity for the Giliran sample seller (PRD 12 v3.1, ADR-0012 D3), from docs/product/personas/giliran.md section 12.2. The prospect is fictional, so research may find little: the checks are on intake, fit, pricing and review. IDs refer to web/src/lib/sample/giliran.ts. A pricing line is checked only if the Pricing step selects it; when it does, code must copy exactly this text and calculate exactly this total.

inputs.text:
REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL KP/HR/2026/014
Payroll, attendance and workforce management system
Issued by Kinabatu Plantations, Sandakan, Sabah. Closing date: 6 November 2026.

1. About us
Kinabatu Plantations runs 14 oil palm estates and 2 palm oil mills in Sabah, with about 7,400 workers. About 70% of them are foreign workers, mostly from Indonesia. Our head office is in Sandakan.

2. Requirements
R1. Malaysian statutory payroll (EPF, SOCSO, EIS and monthly tax deductions) for all 7,400 workers.
R2. Harvesters are paid per tonne of fresh fruit bunches. The system must calculate this piece-rate pay.
R3. Attendance must be recorded at estates without mobile coverage, and synced when coverage returns.
R4. Fingerprint terminals at 16 muster points across the estates.
R5. Payslips in Malay and Indonesian.
R6. Alerts before workers' work permits and passports expire.
R7. Payroll journals posted to the group's finance system.
R8. The system must be installed on Kinabatu's own servers, in our data room in Sandakan.
R9. Three-shift rosters for the 600 workers in our two mills.
R10. System availability of at least 99.9%.
R11. Live by 1 March 2027.

3. Response format
State your compliance against each requirement. Give a price schedule with one-time and recurring costs shown separately. Name two references.

gaps.note: Piece-rate pay is planned, not live. Offer a custom module in man-days, or the roadmap without a date (pinned note nt_piece).

gaps.need: Attendance at estates without mobile coverage
Alerts before work permits and passports expire
Payroll journals posted to the group's finance system

instead.why: Private deployment, from 3,000 employees. Kinabatu has 7,400.

gaps.note: 8 to 16 weeks with two parallel runs (note nt_parallel).

pricing.manDays: 175 days in the persona are entered by a person at Gate C. The Pricing step never invents a quantity for a man-day line.
